summary.en: Canada's Prime Minister's Office said US President Donald Trump met Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Wednesday during the APEC meetings in China to discuss work on a trade agreement between the two countries. The two leaders discussed efforts to reach a reciprocal trade deal that would create quality jobs, improve affordability and fully respect Canada's language, culture and sovereignty. Both sides agreed to keep advancing the work and stay in close contact.
summary.zh_hans: 加拿大总理办公室表示，美国总统特朗普与加拿大总理卡尼星期三在中国举行的APEC会议期间会晤，就两国贸易协议的工作进行讨论。双方讨论为达成互惠贸易协议而进行的工作，协议将创造优质就业机会、提高消费可负担性，并充分尊重加拿大的语言、文化和主权。两人同意继续推进相关工作，并保持密切联系。
summary.zh_hant: 加拿大總理辦公室表示，美國總統特朗普與加拿大總理卡尼星期三在中國舉行的APEC會議期間會晤，就兩國貿易協議的工作進行討論。雙方討論為達成互惠貿易協議而進行的工作，協議將創造優質就業機會、提高消費可負擔性，並充分尊重加拿大的語言、文化和主權。兩人同意繼續推進相關工作，並保持密切聯繫。

title.en: Trump Meets Carney at APEC to Advance Reciprocal Trade Deal Respecting Canadian Sovereignty

summary.en: The Pakistan Army has successfully test-fired the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile. Pakistan's military media wing said the missile is equipped with advanced navigation and propulsion systems, capable of high-precision, high-lethality strikes on long-range targets, and will significantly enhance the operational flexibility and strike range of the Army's rocket force. President Zardari, Prime Minister Shehbaz and Army Chief Munir all congratulated the successful test.
summary.zh_hans: 巴基斯坦陆军成功试射“法塔赫－3”超音速巡航导弹。巴基斯坦三军新闻局表示，导弹配备先进的导航和推进系统，能对远距离目标实施高精度、高杀伤力打击，将显著提升陆军火箭部队的作战灵活性和打击范围。总统扎尔达里、总理夏巴兹及陆军参谋长穆尼尔均祝贺试射成功。
summary.zh_hant: 巴基斯坦陸軍成功試射「法塔赫－3」超音速巡航導彈。巴基斯坦三軍新聞局表示，導彈配備先進的導航和推進系統，能對遠距離目標實施高精度、高殺傷力打擊，將顯著提升陸軍火箭部隊的作戰靈活性和打擊範圍。總統扎爾達里、總理夏巴茲及陸軍參謀長穆尼爾均祝賀試射成功。

title.en: Pakistan Test-Fires Fatah-3 Supersonic Cruise Missile in Major Boost to Strike Range

summary.en: The US Democratic Party has nominated House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House of Representatives, and he is poised to become the first Black Speaker in American history. The House Democratic caucus approved the nomination in a closed-door vote on Wednesday, but Jeffries still needs majority support in a full House vote in January next year before he can formally take the post. The Democrats retook control of both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections earlier this month, with the new Congress starting its term on 3 January.
summary.zh_hans: 美国民主党提名现任众议院民主党领袖杰弗里斯为众议院议长，他有望成为美国历史上首位非洲裔众议院议长。众议院民主党党团星期三举行闭门投票通过提名，但杰弗里斯仍需在明年1月新一届众议院全体会议投票中获得过半数支持，才可正式出任议长。民主党在月初的中期选举夺回国会参众两院控制权，新一届国会任期将于明年1月3日开始。
summary.zh_hant: 美國民主黨提名現任眾議院民主黨領袖傑弗里斯為眾議院議長，他有望成為美國歷史上首位非洲裔眾議院議長。眾議院民主黨黨團星期三舉行閉門投票通過提名，但傑弗里斯仍需在明年1月新一屆眾議院全體會議投票中獲得過半數支持，才可正式出任議長。民主黨在月初的中期選舉奪回國會參眾兩院控制權，新一屆國會任期將於明年1月3日開始。

title.en: Democrats Nominate Jeffries for House Speaker in Historic First for a Black American

summary.en: China and South Korea have substantively concluded the second phase of negotiations on their free trade agreement, the Ministry of Commerce said. The talks, guided by the consensus reached by the two countries' leaders, took more than eight years. The upgrade covers the investment, services trade, financial services and economic cooperation chapters of the original agreement, raising the level of investment and services liberalisation and facilitation, and adopts a negative-list model for opening commitments in investment, cross-border services trade and financial services, setting transparent, stable and predictable market-access rules for two-way investment and services trade. The two sides also agreed on implementation arrangements for economic cooperation, including traditional medicine services, cultural cooperation and internet services.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部表示，中韩双方以两国元首重要共识为指引，推进中韩自贸协定第二阶段谈判，历经8年多时间，在近日实质性完成，达成互利共赢的高水平谈判成果。中韩自贸协定第二阶段对原中韩自贸协定投资、服务贸易、金融服务和经济合作章及有关附件进行升级，进一步提升了双方投资和服务自由化、便利化规则水平，并采用负面清单模式针对投资、跨境服务贸易、金融服务等领域作出开放承诺，为后续双向投资和服务贸易往来建立了透明、稳定、可预期的准入规则。另外，双方又制定了经济合作领域具体实施安排，涵盖传统医学服务合作、文化合作和网络服务合作等内容。
summary.zh_hant: 商務部表示，中韓雙方以兩國元首重要共識為指引，推進中韓自貿協定第二階段談判，歷經8年幾時間，喺近日實質性完成，達成互利共贏嘅高水平談判成果。中韓自貿協定第二階段對原中韓自貿協定投資、服務貿易、金融服務同經濟合作章及有關附件進行升級，進一步提升咗雙方投資同服務自由化、便利化規則水平，並採用負面清單模式針對投資、跨境服務貿易、金融服務等領域作出開放承諾，為後續雙向投資同服務貿易往來建立透明、穩定、可預期嘅准入規則。另外，雙方又制定咗經濟合作領域具體實施安排，涵蓋傳統醫學服務合作、文化合作同網絡服務合作等內容。

title.en: China and South Korea Substantively Conclude Second-Phase FTA Talks After Eight Years; Negative-List Opening for Investment and Services

summary.en: The South Pacific island nation of Fiji has declared a nationwide state of disaster as it battles a rare prolonged drought and a severe water shortage. Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka said the declaration allows the government to centrally deploy emergency teams, relief supplies and public resources, and that special relief funds have been set aside for emergency water supply, help for affected communities, and relief for agriculture and livestock. Authorities warn that 75 per cent of water sources will be at warning level by the end of November, and the figure could exceed 82 per cent by next January, leaving more than 80 per cent of the country's water supply at risk of running dry.
summary.zh_hans: 南太平洋岛国斐济遭遇罕见持续干旱，当地星期三宣布全国进入灾难状态，全力应对严峻缺水危机。斐济总理兰布卡表示，灾难状态启动后，政府将有权统一调配应急队伍、救灾物资及各类公共资源，当局已拨出专项救灾资金，用于应急供水保障、受灾社区帮扶、农业养殖救济及干旱衍生灾害处置等工作。斐济当局警告，当地11月底警戒级缺水水源占比将攀升至75%，到明年1月这个比例可能突破82%，届时全国超过八成供水水源将面临枯竭危机。
summary.zh_hant: 南太平洋島國斐濟遭遇罕見持續乾旱，當地星期三宣布全國進入災難狀態，全力應對嚴峻缺水危機。斐濟總理蘭布卡表示，災難狀態啟動後，政府將有權統一調配應急隊伍、救災物資及各類公共資源，當局已撥出專項救災資金，用於應急供水保障、受災社區幫扶、農業養殖救濟及乾旱衍生災害處置等工作。斐濟當局警告，當地11月底警戒級缺水水源佔比將攀升至75%，到明年1月呢個比例可能突破82%，屆時全國超過八成供水水源將面臨枯竭危機。

title.en: Fiji Declares Nationwide State of Disaster as Rare Drought Bites; Over 80% of Water Sources May Run Dry by January

summary.en: The opening ceremonies for Business of Design Week 2026 and DesignInspire were held on November 18, launching four major design events running in Hong Kong until November 29, including the city programme DESIGN@HKG 2026 and the deTour 2026 Design Festival. DesignInspire, organised by the Trade Development Council, runs until November 21 with more than 200 exhibitors from 17 countries and regions under the theme "Wander & Wonder". The Hong Kong Design Centre also hosted "Vividly Hong Kong" at the DX design hub on the same evening to mark its second anniversary and the opening of seven new exhibitions.
summary.zh_hans: 设计营商周2026与DesignInspire的开幕典礼于11月18日举行，连同全城节目DESIGN@HKG 2026及deTour 2026设计节，四大设计盛事即日起至11月29日在香港先后或同期举行。由贸发局主办的DesignInspire即日起至11月21日举行，主题为“Wander & Wonder”，汇聚17个国家及地区逾200家参展商。香港设计中心当晚亦在DX设计枢纽举办“Vividly Hong Kong”，庆祝DX设计枢纽成立两周年及七个新展览开幕。
summary.zh_hant: 設計營商周2026同DesignInspire嘅開幕典禮喺11月18日舉行，連同全城節目DESIGN@HKG 2026及deTour 2026設計節，四大設計盛事即日起至11月29號喺香港先後或同期舉行。由貿發局主辦嘅DesignInspire即日起至11月21號舉行，主題係「Wander & Wonder」，匯聚17個國家及地區逾200家參展商。香港設計中心同晚亦喺DX設計樞紐舉辦「Vividly Hong Kong」，慶祝DX設計樞紐成立兩周年及七個新展覽開幕。

title.en: Business of Design Week and DesignInspire Open Together; Four Design Events Run Until November 29 With 200 Exhibitors

summary.en: US pending home sales fell further in October, with the National Association of Realtors index down 4.7 per cent to 63, a fresh record low and a bigger drop than the 2 per cent the market had expected. Compared with a year earlier, the index plunged 16.7 per cent.

summary.zh_hant: 全美不動產協會數據顯示，美國10月二手樓臨時買賣合約指數下跌4.7%，降至63，再創新低，跌幅多過市場估計嘅2%。按年比較，指數大跌16.7%。

title.en: US Pending Home Sales Fall 4.7% to Record Low of 63, Down 16.7% Year on Year and Far Worse Than Expected

summary.en: The Chief Executive's Office said one of its vehicles was turning slowly from Gloucester Road into Fenwick Street in Wan Chai at about 5:48 pm when a pedestrian suddenly dashed across the road where there was no pedestrian crossing. The driver braked in time and called police. Police confirmed the pedestrian had crossed the road illegally, and the pedestrian declined to go to hospital for further checks. The incident was recorded.
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官办公室表示，一辆特首办车辆昨日下午约5时48分，在湾仔告士打道慢驶左转入分域街时，一名途人在没有行人过路设施的路段突然冲出马路，司机及时刹停车辆并即场报警。警方到场后确认涉事途人违规横过马路，该途人拒绝到医院接受进一步检查，事件作备案处理。
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官辦公室表示，一輛特首辦車輛昨日下午約5時48分，喺灣仔告士打道慢駛左轉入分域街嗰陣，一名途人喺冇行人過路設施嘅路段突然衝出馬路，司機及時煞停車輛並即場報警。警方到場後確認涉事途人違規橫過馬路，該途人拒絕去醫院接受進一步檢查，事件作備案處理。

title.en: Chief Executive's Office Vehicle Brakes in Time as Pedestrian Dashes Across Wan Chai Road; Police Confirm Jaywalking

summary.en: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said inflation is still heading in the wrong direction and spreading, and the Fed should act more aggressively, including considering a half-point rate rise in December or clearly signalling faster hikes next year. He said the recent annualised inflation rate has exceeded 3 per cent and may be accelerating, driven mainly by services, and warned that if company managers treat it as normal and pass it on to consumers, it will become harder to contain. Waller said the market needs to understand that 3 per cent inflation is not the Fed's target, and expectations of only one quarter-point rise should be overturned.
summary.zh_hans: 美国联储局理事沃勒表示，通胀仍在朝错误的方向发展，而且正在蔓延，联储局应采取更进取的措施应对，包括考虑在12月加息半厘，或者明确表达明年将加快加息步伐。沃勒接受外电访问时表示，近期的年化通胀率已超过3%，并可能正在加速，而且价格升势主要受服务业影响，认为与高油价及其他短暂性因素影响有限，忧虑企业管理层会视之为常态，并转嫁予消费者，到时要压抑通胀就会变得困难。他又说，市场对当前价格水平的接受程度超出预期，有需要让市场意识到3%的通胀率并非当局的目标水平，并推翻市场对于联储局只会加息1次、加幅只有0.25厘的预期。
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯儲局理事沃勒表示，通脹仍在朝錯誤嘅方向發展，而且正在蔓延，聯儲局應採取更進取嘅措施應對，包括考慮喺12月加息半厘，或者明確表達明年將加快加息步伐。沃勒接受外電訪問時表示，近期嘅年化通脹率已超過3%，並可能正在加速，而且價格升勢主要受服務業影響，認為與高油價及其他短暫性因素影響有限，憂慮企業管理層會視之為常態，並轉嫁予消費者，到時要壓抑通脹就會變得困難。佢又話，市場對當前價格水平嘅接受程度超出預期，有需要令市場意識到3%嘅通脹率並非當局嘅目標水平，並推翻市場對於聯儲局只會加息1次、加幅只有0.25厘嘅預期。

title.en: Fed's Waller Urges Consideration of Half-Point December Hike as Inflation Tops 3% and Heads the Wrong Way

summary.en: Two public toilets managed by the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department have won gold and bronze awards in this year's Hong Kong's Best Public Toilet Award. The gold winner, the Lei Yue Mun (Ling Nam Sun Tsuen) Public Toilet in Kwun Tong, uses the winning design from the PT 2.0 Public Toilet Design Competition, with a modular structure, accessible toilets with automatic doors, real-time odour monitoring and a smart accident detection system. The bronze winner is the refurbished Aberdeen Main Road Public Toilet in Southern District. The department manages more than 800 public toilets, and refurbishment works have been rolled out for nearly 85 per cent of those covered by its enhancement programme.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署管理的两个公厕在今年香港最佳公厕选举中夺得金奖及铜奖。金奖得主是观塘鲤鱼门（岭南新村）公厕，采用“公厕2.0”设计比赛优胜概念，模组式结构可灵活配合不同地形，设有自动门无障碍厕所、实时气味监测系统及智能意外侦测系统。铜奖得主是翻新后的南区香港仔大道公厕。食环署现管理逾800个公厕，优化翻新计划覆盖的公厕中，近85%已展开工程。
summary.zh_hant: 食環署管理嘅兩個公廁喺今年香港最佳公廁選舉中奪得金獎及銅獎。金獎得主係觀塘鯉魚門（嶺南新村）公廁，採用「公廁2.0」設計比賽優勝概念，模組式結構可以靈活配合唔同地形，設有自動門無障礙廁所、實時氣味監測系統及智能意外偵測系統。銅獎得主係翻新後嘅南區香港仔大道公廁。食環署現時管理逾800個公廁，優化翻新計劃覆蓋嘅公廁當中，近85%已經展開工程。

title.en: FEHD Public Toilets Win Gold and Bronze in Best Public Toilet Award; Lei Yue Mun Smart Toilet Takes Gold
title.zh_hans: 食环署两公厕夺最佳公厕金铜奖 鲤鱼门智能公厕夺金 800公厕翻新近85%已展开

summary.en: US housing starts rebounded in October, rising 9.9 per cent month on month to an annualised 1.309 million units, beating market expectations of 1.245 million and up 2.8 per cent from a year earlier, after a 7 per cent fall in September. Building permits told a different story, however, falling 7.4 per cent to an annualised 1.295 million units, below the expected 1.377 million and down 8.7 per cent year on year.

summary.en: A first-alarm fire broke out in the evening in a flat in Chim Uk Tsuen, Shuen Wan, Tai Po. A woman who inhaled smoke felt unwell and was taken to hospital conscious after first aid from paramedics. The Fire Services Department received the report at 5:59 pm, arrived four minutes later, and had the fire largely under control by 6:18 pm with one hose jet and one breathing apparatus team. About 20 residents evacuated on their own, and firefighters rescued two dogs and a cat from the flat. The fire is believed to have started in the living room, possibly from an electrical short circuit, and is not thought to be suspicious.

summary.en: The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, officiated at the opening ceremony of Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Central on November 18, kicking off the Hong Kong WinterFest organised by the Tourism Board. Building on last year's successful debut, the experience expands this year to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, each with its own themed light show, while the facades of several iconic Central landmarks will be illuminated from tonight until early January. Tonight also marks the grand finale of "A Symphony of Lights", which has run for 22 years and was recognised by Guinness World Records in 2005 as the world's largest permanent light and sound show, closing with a rooftop pyrotechnics display.

summary.en: Police have broken up an online shopping fraud ring selling electronic gift cards, involving at least 35 cases in which victims lost more than HK$650,000. Eleven people were arrested. The group used large numbers of real-name registered SIM cards to open shopping platform accounts and advertised gift cards at 10 to 20 per cent below market price, luring victims to transfer money to bank accounts controlled by the group before issuing invalid redemption codes. The seven men and four women arrested are aged 19 to 74 and include the suspected ringleader, the registrants of the phone numbers and platform accounts, and the bank account holders.
summary.zh_hans: 警方瓦解一个涉及电子产品礼品卡的网购骗案集团，涉及至少35宗同类骗案，受害人共损失超过65万元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，诈骗集团收取大量已实名登记的电话卡，用作开设网购平台账户，以低于市价10%至20%的价钱刊登放售电子产品礼品卡，诱使受害人转账至集团操控的银行户口，其后向受害人提供无效兑换码。被捕的7男4女年龄介乎19至74岁，包括集团主脑、电话号码及网上购物平台户口登记人，以及银行户口持有人等。
summary.zh_hant: 警方瓦解一個涉及電子產品禮品卡嘅網購騙案集團，涉及至少35宗同類騙案，受害人共損失超過65萬元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，詐騙集團收取大量已實名登記嘅電話卡，用作開設網購平台帳戶，以低於市價10%至20%嘅價錢刊登放售電子產品禮品卡，誘使受害人轉帳至集團操控嘅銀行戶口，其後向受害人提供無效兌換碼。被捕嘅7男4女年齡介乎19至74歲，包括集團主腦、電話號碼及網上購物平台戶口登記人，以及銀行戶口持有人等。

title.en: Police Smash Gift Card Shopping Scam Ring, Arrest 11 in 35 Cases; Victims Lose Over HK$650,000

summary.en: The onshore yuan closed at a more than half-month high against the US dollar, finishing at 6.6653 per dollar, up 2 pips. The daily fixing has risen for five straight sessions to a near four-and-a-half-year high, coming in about 460 pips weaker than the market had forecast. Market watchers expect limited yuan movement ahead of the meeting of the Chinese, US and Russian leaders, while HSBC said persistent dollar strength and weak mainland economic fundamentals are holding back the yuan's rise, expecting it to hold near 6.65 per dollar by year-end with scope for mild appreciation next year.

summary.zh_hant: 在岸人民幣兌美元收市創逾半個月新高，收報6.6653兌1美元，微升2點子。中間價連升5個交易日，創近4年半新高，較市場預測偏弱約460點子。市場人士認為，中美俄元首會晤在即，預計人民幣變動有限。滙豐認為，近期美元持續走強，加上內地經濟基本面偏弱，抑制人民幣升勢，預計人民幣年底可能維持喺6.65兌1美元水平附近，明年有望繼續溫和升值。

summary.en: Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) has released its 2027 World University Rankings for Sustainability, with 11 Hong Kong universities making the list and nine of them entering the top 1,000. The University of Hong Kong ranks 161st, the highest in the city, while Hong Kong Metropolitan University rose three places to 928th. The rankings cover about 2,000 universities from 107 countries and regions; Hong Kong institutions perform strongly in employability and environmental research, with four universities in the world's top 50 for environmental research.

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a second straight day. The Hang Seng Index dropped as much as 300 points intraday before closing at 23,294, down 213 points or 0.91 per cent, with main-board turnover of nearly HK$177.2 billion. The tech index closed at 3,736, down 0.6 per cent, with all ATMXJ stocks lower. JD.com shares fell more than 7 per cent and JD Health plunged more than 15 per cent after results, the worst performers among Hang Seng and tech index constituents, while JD Logistics fell more than 2 per cent and JD Industrials rose nearly 6 per cent against the trend. Lenovo rose more than 4 per cent, the best blue chip, and carmakers mostly gained, with Nio and XPeng up more than 2 to 3 per cent.

summary.en: TVB has invited Andy Hui to be the finale guest at its anniversary gala, "TVM Gala 2026", airing live on November 19, where he will perform a medley of classic hits with a live band. Attention has focused on whether Hui may cross paths with Kenneth Ma, who is taking part in the opening song-and-dance segment, in what would be their first time at the same event seven years after the 2019 "On Sum" scandal, when the married Hui was caught kissing Jacqueline Wong, then Ma's girlfriend, in a taxi. Hui's 33-year career stalled after he admitted he was a "broken man", but he returned to the Hong Kong Coliseum in October with three well-received concerts. Ma has said he forgave both of them long ago and bears no grudge, though many netizens have rallied behind him online, with some urging him to skip the gala to avoid an awkward scene.
summary.zh_hans: 无线公布，许志安将担任明晚（19日）举行的《万千星辉贺台庆》压轴表演嘉宾，在现场乐队伴奏下献唱经典金曲Medley。外界焦点落在他可能会与有份参与序幕歌舞环节的马国明相遇，正是2019年“安心事件”7年后，二人将首度同场，引发热议。2019年，已婚的许志安被揭发与当时正与马国明拍拖的黄心颖在的士车厢内激吻，事件震撼全城。许志安自认“坏了的人”，其长达33年的演艺事业随即停摆；经过7年沉淀，他于今年10月重踏红馆舞台，连开3场演唱会并获外界高度评价。马国明曾公开表示早已原谅二人，从未对两人心存怨恨，但大批网民仍为马国明抱不平，在网上留言质疑电视台是否尊重他，甚至揣测他会否缺席明晚盛会。
summary.zh_hant: 無綫公布，許志安將擔任明晚（19日）舉行嘅《萬千星輝賀台慶》壓軸表演嘉賓，喺現場樂隊伴奏下獻唱經典金曲Medley。外界焦點落喺佢可能會同有份參與序幕歌舞環節嘅馬國明相遇，正係2019年「安心事件」7年後，兩人將首度同場，引發熱議。2019年，已婚嘅許志安被揭發同當時正與馬國明拍拖嘅黃心穎喺的士車廂內激吻，事件震撼全城。許志安自認「壞咗的人」，其長達33年嘅演藝事業隨即停擺；經過7年沉澱，佢喺今年10月重踏紅館舞台，連開3場演唱會並獲外界高度評價。馬國明曾公開表示早已原諒二人，從未對兩人心存怨恨，但大批網民仍為馬國明抱不平，喺網上留言質疑電視台係咪尊重佢，甚至揣測佢會唔會缺席明晚盛會。

summary.en: President Xi Jinping met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen during the APEC CEO Summit. Putin said safeguarding prosperity in the Asia-Pacific is a shared goal of Russia and China, and bilateral trade has substantially exceeded US$200 billion for several consecutive years, a level it will reach again this year and keep growing. Visa-free arrangements between the two countries have driven tourist numbers up 43%, and Putin said Russia-China diplomatic coordination remains stable and active, committed to building a fairer multipolar world order.

summary.zh_hant: 國家主席習近平在深圳會見出席APEC工商領導人會議的俄羅斯總統普京。普京表示，保障亞太地區繁榮是俄中的共同目標，兩國貿易額已連續幾年大幅超過2000億美元大關，今年不僅將再次達到這一水平，而且將繼續增長。兩國實施免簽制度後，遊客大幅增長43%；普京又說，俄中外交協作配合穩定、積極運作，致力構建更加公正的多極世界秩序。

summary.en: Police have cracked a mortgage fraud case and arrested a first-year student at a local private university, who was allegedly used by a fraud ring to pose as law firm staff and meet a victim to trick them into transferring HK$800,000. The scammers first impersonated bank staff to pitch a low-interest mortgage, then claimed a high-interest fixed deposit could offset the interest, arranging to meet the victim at Elements in Yau Ma Tei on Monday to sign a mortgage application. After transferring the money, the victim called the real law firm and discovered the fraud; officers arrested the student at the scene, and the case is being followed up by Yau Tsim Police District.
summary.zh_hans: 警方侦破一宗楼宇按揭骗案，拘捕一名就读本港私立大学一年级的姓萧男生，他涉嫌被诈骗集团利用，假扮律师事务所职员与受害人会面，诱骗对方转账 80 万元。骗徒先假扮银行职员推销低息房贷，再讹称可透过高息定期存款抵消利息，约受害人星期一在油麻地圆方会面签署按揭申请表。受害人转账后致电真正律师行查询始揭发受骗，警员到场拘捕男生，案件由油尖警区跟进。
summary.zh_hant: 警方偵破一宗樓宇按揭騙案，拘捕一名就讀本港私立大學一年級的姓蕭男生，他涉嫌被詐騙集團利用，假扮律師事務所職員與受害人會面，誘騙對方轉賬 80 萬元。騙徒先假扮銀行職員推銷低息房貸，再訛稱可透過高息定期存款抵消利息，約受害人星期一在油麻地圓方會面簽署按揭申請表。受害人轉賬後致電真正律師行查詢始揭發受騙，警員到場拘捕男生，案件由油尖警區跟進。

summary.en: Apple suffered a large-scale network outage on 17 November, affecting the App Store, Apple Music, iCloud sign-in and payments, with thousands of fault reports logged on Downdetector. Apple confirmed the outage was caused by an internal system update that morning, that most services have been restored, and that it was not a cyberattack. Google's email service and Marriott's online platforms also saw user-reported faults on the same day; the US has recently seen a string of tech failures involving Microsoft cloud, FAA air traffic control and United Airlines, with no evidence linking them.
summary.zh_hans: 苹果公司 11 月 17 日发生大规模网络技术故障，应用商店、音乐、云端存储登录及支付等多项服务受影响，故障报告网站收到数千宗相关报告。苹果证实，故障由当天上午一次内部系统更新引起，目前大部分系统已恢复，并确认并非网络攻击所致。同一天，谷歌电邮服务及万豪酒店网络平台亦出现用户报告故障；美国近期接连出现多宗技术系统故障，涉及微软云服务、联邦航空局空管系统及联合航空等，暂无证据显示有关联。
summary.zh_hant: 蘋果公司 11 月 17 日發生大規模網絡技術故障，應用商店、音樂、雲端存儲登錄及支付等多項服務受影響，故障報告網站收到數千宗相關報告。蘋果證實，故障由當天上午一次內部系統更新引起，目前大部分系統已恢復，並確認並非網絡攻擊所致。同一天，谷歌電郵服務及萬豪酒店網絡平台亦出現用戶報告故障；美國近期接連出現多宗技術系統故障，涉及微軟雲服務、聯邦航空局空管系統及聯合航空等，暫無證據顯示有關聯。

summary.en: Gold hit a near 14-month low as Federal Reserve meeting minutes and public remarks by officials sent hawkish signals, lifting rate-hike expectations and the dollar, weighing on bullion. Spot gold at one point fell below US$3,720 an ounce, down about 3.4%, before hovering around US$3,725. December gold futures in New York closed at US$3,741.9, down about 3.2%.

summary.en: Oil prices fell again as data showed US crude and fuel inventories rising more than expected, deepening oversupply concerns. Brent crude for January fell as much as 3% to a low of US$90.34 a barrel before closing at US$91.95, down about 1.3%. NYMEX crude for December at one point plunged about 4.7%, breaking below US$82 a barrel to a near three-month low, before closing at US$83.26, down about 3.2%. US Energy Information Administration data showed gasoline inventories up about 5.2 million barrels last week, distillate inventories up about 1.6 million barrels and crude inventories up about 3.4 million barrels last week, all above expectations.
summary.zh_hans: 油价再度转跌，数据显示美国原油及燃料库存增幅超出预期，加剧市场对供应过剩的担忧。布兰特期油1月合约最多跌3%，每桶低见90.34美元，收报91.95美元，跌约1.3%。纽约期油12月合约一度急挫约4.7%，跌穿82美元一桶，创近3个月新低，收报83.26美元，跌幅收窄至约3.2%。美国能源信息署数据显示，上星期汽油库存增加约520万桶，蒸馏油库存增加约160万桶，原油库存亦增加约340万桶，全部多于预期。
summary.zh_hant: 油價再度轉跌，數據顯示美國原油及燃料庫存增幅超出預期，加劇市場對供應過剩的擔憂。布蘭特期油1月合約最多跌3%，每桶低見90.34美元，收報91.95美元，跌約1.3%。紐約期油12月合約一度急挫約4.7%，跌穿82美元一桶，創近3個月新低，收報83.26美元，跌幅收窄至約3.2%。美國能源信息署數據顯示，上星期汽油庫存增加約520萬桶，蒸餾油庫存增加約160萬桶，原油庫存亦增加約340萬桶，全部多於預期。

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks trading as American depositary receipts (ADRs) were mostly sharply lower. Tencent was sold off after its results and Alibaba was also under pressure ahead of its results, with both ADRs down about 3% from their Hong Kong closes — Tencent at the equivalent of HK$361.3 and Alibaba at HK$82.7. HSBC's ADR fell over 2% to the equivalent of HK$132.8, while Bank of China, HKEX, Ping An, Meituan and Xiaomi ADRs fell over 1% to about 2%. CCB and JD.com ADRs rose, but only modestly.
summary.zh_hans: 港股美国预托证券（ADR）大多跌幅显著。腾讯业绩后股价捱沽，阿里巴巴业绩公布前亦受压，两者ADR都比本港昨日收市价跌约3%，以港元计，腾讯ADR折合报361.3元，阿里巴巴ADR折合报82.7元。汇控ADR跌逾2%，折合报132.8元；中行、港交所、平保、美团、小米ADR跌逾1%至约2%。建行及京东集团ADR则升，但升幅有限。

summary.en: The three major US indices moved in different directions after Federal Reserve minutes showed officials were already leaning towards a rate hike — even by 0.5 percentage points — before data showed inflation heating up. The Dow tested the 50,000 level, falling as much as 730 points before closing at 50,198, down 561 points or 1.1%, a third straight daily fall and an over five-month low. The S&P 500 fell for a fifth straight session to 7,323, down over 0.2% to a near four-month low, while the Nasdaq rebounded to 24,429, up over 0.4%. Nvidia fell nearly 3%, down for five straight sessions and about 37% below its early-October closing record high.
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数个别发展，联储局会议纪录显示，在数据显示通胀升温前，委员已倾向加息，甚至认为需要加息0.5厘。道琼斯指数下试5万点关口，最多跌730点，收报50,198点，跌561点，跌幅1.1%，连跌3日，创逾5个月新低。标普500指数五连跌，收报7,323点，跌逾0.2%，创近4个月低位；纳斯达克指数反弹，收报24,429点，升逾0.4%。Nvidia股价低收近3%，连跌5个交易日，较10月初创下的收市纪录高位累计回吐约37%。
summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數個別發展，聯儲局會議紀錄顯示，在數據顯示通脹升溫前，委員已傾向加息，甚至認為需要加息0.5厘。道瓊斯指數下試5萬點關口，最多跌730點，收報50,198點，跌561點，跌幅1.1%，連跌3日，創逾5個月新低。標普500指數五連跌，收報7,323點，跌逾0.2%，創近4個月低位；納斯達克指數反彈，收報24,429點，升逾0.4%。Nvidia股價低收近3%，連跌5個交易日，較10月初創下的收市紀錄高位累計回吐約37%。

summary.en: President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump will hold trilateral talks in Shenzhen today. China's foreign ministry said the three leaders will exchange views in depth on major issues concerning global peace. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov expects the meeting to last no more than an hour, while Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov said the three leaders will decide for themselves how long the discussion runs.
summary.zh_hans: 国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京及美国总统特朗普，今日将在深圳举行三方会谈。外交部表示，三国元首将就事关全球和平的重要问题深入交换意见。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫预计会晤不会超过一小时，俄罗斯总统助理乌沙科夫则表示，三人将自行决定讨论持续多久。
summary.zh_hant: 國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普京及美國總統特朗普，今日將在深圳舉行三方會談。外交部表示，三國元首將就事關全球和平的重要問題深入交換意見。克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫預計會晤不會超過一小時，俄羅斯總統助理烏沙科夫則表示，三人將自行決定討論持續多久。

summary.en: US and Russian officials say US President Donald Trump is expected to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin bilaterally during the APEC summit in Shenzhen today, before joining Chinese President Xi Jinping for trilateral talks. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the two will hold a bilateral meeting but no full-scale bilateral negotiations are planned. Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov said the meeting will take place after the APEC plenary session, with several members of both delegations expected to attend.
summary.zh_hans: 美国和俄罗斯官员表示，美国总统特朗普今日在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间，预料会与俄罗斯总统普京举行双边会谈，随后还将与中国国家主席习近平举行三方会晤。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫表示，两人将举行双边会谈，但不会安排全面双边谈判。俄罗斯总统助理乌沙科夫表示，会晤将在亚太经合组织全体会议结束后举行，俄美代表团数名成员预计将出席。
summary.zh_hant: 美國和俄羅斯官員表示，美國總統特朗普今日在深圳舉行的亞太經合組織峰會期間，預料會與俄羅斯總統普京舉行雙邊會談，隨後還將與中國國家主席習近平舉行三方會晤。克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫表示，兩人將舉行雙邊會談，但不會安排全面雙邊談判。俄羅斯總統助理烏沙科夫表示，會晤將在亞太經合組織全體會議結束後舉行，俄美代表團數名成員預計將出席。

summary.en: A 45-year-old woman had both ovaries wrongly removed during laparoscopic surgery to remove her uterus and fallopian tubes at CUHK Medical Centre. Consultant gynaecological oncologist Dr Cheung Tak-hong told RTHK he was the operating surgeon, describing the incident as an error that should not have happened — a very basic mistake that should not have been made — and saying he is deeply sorry. He said he explained the situation to the patient and her family the same evening and apologised again at a meeting the next day, pledging to look after her; the patient has accepted his apology and chosen to remain under his care. Cheung said the patient can live normally with appropriate treatment and medication.
summary.zh_hans: 一名45岁女病人在中大医院接受腹腔镜子宫及双侧输卵管切除手术期间，两边卵巢被错误切除。中大医院顾问医生、妇科肿瘤科专科医生张德康接受本台访问时承认，他是当日施手术的医生，形容事故是不应该发生、很低级、不应该犯的错误，深感抱歉。他表示，当晚已立即与病人及家人说明情况，翌日再次在会面上承认错误并道歉，承诺会尽量照顾病人；病人已接受道歉，并选择继续由他跟进及照顾。张德康表示，病人接受适当治疗、药物后可以正常生活，不受事件影响。
summary.zh_hant: 一名45歲女病人在中大醫院接受腹腔鏡子宮及雙側輸卵管切除手術期間，兩邊卵巢被錯誤切除。中大醫院顧問醫生、婦科腫瘤科專科醫生張德康接受本台訪問時承認，他是當日施手術的醫生，形容事故是不應該發生、很低級、不應該犯的錯誤，深感抱歉。他表示，當晚已立即與病人及家人說明情況，翌日再次在會面上承認錯誤並道歉，承諾會盡量照顧病人；病人已接受道歉，並選擇繼續由他跟進及照顧。張德康表示，病人接受適當治療、藥物後可以正常生活，不受事件影響。

title.en: Doctor admits wrongly removing patient's ovaries was a basic error, apologises and pledges follow-up care
